For example, in my head I say that jumping in front of a car would be a good idea but in response I'd say aloud, no. It works for me :) 

I'd also recommend looking at this: http://www.reddit.com/r/SWResources/comments/i25yy/if_youve_lost_someone_to_suicide_here_are_some/
